sources.title: Family testimony, Patricia and Ronald Andrews
sources.repository: Family papers, 2026.

Pat and Ron are buried together in the churchyard of St John the Baptist Parish Church, Waterloo Road, Crowthorne, Berkshire (family). The family confirms Auntie Babs was Eileen Sybil FitzMaurice.
